title.value: Artificial intelligence in nursing: Priorities and opportunities from an international invitational think-tank of the Nursing and Artificial Intelligence Leadership Collaborative
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and repeated multiple times within the document.
title.quote: Artificial intelligence in nursing: social, ethical and legal implications’.

analysis.description: This paper aims to establish a consensus on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in nursing, highlighting priorities and opportunities through deliberations of the Nursing and Artificial Intelligence Leadership Collaborative. The paper discusses implications for nursing education, practice, research, and leadership pertaining to AI technologies.

type.justification: The paper focuses on establishing priorities and theoretical frameworks for integrating AI into nursing practices rather than conducting empirical studies or experiments.
type.quote: The NAIL Collaborative convened at a 3-day invitational think tank... Activities included a pre-event survey, expert presentations and working sessions to identify priority areas for action, opportunities and recommendations to address these. In this paper, we summarize the key discussion points and notes from the aforementioned activities.

name.justification: The paper discusses the application of artificial intelligence within the nursing and healthcare context, addressing the implications and requirements for its integration.
name.quote: Artificial intelligence (AI) is defined as ‘... the science and engineering of making intelligent machines, especially intelligent computer programs’ (McCarthy, 1956). Increasingly sophisticated AI... In healthcare, AI is being adopted to aid healthcare professionals deliver high-quality care more efficiently and equitably.

name.justification: The paper discusses the application of AI specifically within the nursing domain, addressing how it affects documentation and nursing practices.
name.quote: In the context of nursing, examples of applications of AI demonstrate the potential impact that the use of these technologies can have in nursing practice.
